name: Shuurei Mikagami
source:
A 15 year old exorcist with excellent grades and good manners. He serves as the dormitory manager and is also in charge of preparing meals, hence why he's almost like a mother to everyone in the Spiritus Corps. His Deva is Zachariel.

Although he has handed over the captaincy to Munakata, there are rumors that he manages the stubborn leader well. He scary when mad.

[Translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/dc/02_chara/05.htm]official website[/url]]
